value.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for a handwritten statements to text agent kit
value.lets_workers: Type each handwritten page in a drop folder exactly as written, keeping slang, spelling, grammar, acronyms, crossings-out and the writer's own words, and flag every word the agent is unsure of. A local acronym glossary helps readers without ever changing the text. A person checks every flag against the page, trained staff follow up on anything about safety, and the program lead signs off and decides how a statement is used.
human_only: Check every flagged reading against the original page.
Follow up in person when a statement raises safety.
Sign off the transcription and decide how it is used.
Share a statement outside the organization.
rules: Use only synthetic, clearly marked test data. Never put a real person's details into the kit, a test case or an output.
Steps marked for a person stay with people. The agent drafts or helps; it never decides about a person and never contacts anyone.
Tools are read-only. Anything that changes records outside the requester's scope is a person's step.

value.title: Handwritten Statements to Text Kit
value.category_reason: The agent's whole setup as one noun: its step map and pins to every part.
value.summary: Types handwritten statements and forms dropped into a folder exactly as written, keeping slang, spelling, acronyms and the writer's own words, and flags every uncertain reading for a person. A local acronym glossary helps readers but never changes the text, and a person checks every flag and signs off.
value.goal: Help an organization turn handwritten statements and forms dropped into a folder into faithful typed text that keeps every word as written, flags every uncertain reading and lists acronyms against a local glossary, while a person checks every flag against the original, trained staff follow up on safety, and the program lead signs off and decides how a statement is used.
value.target_org: Community center that collects handwritten statements and sign-up cards at community nights

step_map.title: Type each page exactly as written
step_map.guidance: Type each line as written, keeping spelling, slang, grammar, acronyms, crossings-out and line breaks. Mark every unsure reading with [?], mark unreadable words [illegible], and never correct or tidy the writer's words.

step_map.title: List acronyms and local terms against the glossary
step_map.guidance: List every acronym or local term found, with its glossary meaning when the glossary has one; unknown ones go to the reviewer. The glossary never changes the transcription.

step_map.title: Check every flagged reading against the original page
step_map.guidance: A person compares every flag and a sample of other lines with the original page, fixes misreadings only, and keeps the writer's own words, spelling and slang.

step_map.title: Follow up in person when a statement raises safety
step_map.guidance: When a statement mentions danger or not feeling safe, trained staff follow up under the organization's own safety protocol. The agent gives no advice and takes no other step.

step_map.title: Sign off the transcription and decide how it is used
step_map.guidance: The program lead signs off each transcription and decides how the statement is used, under the organization's consent and records rules.

step_map.title: Share a statement outside the organization
step_map.guidance: Only staff share a statement outside the organization, and only with the writer's consent. The agent never shares or sends anything.

value.title: Skill: type handwritten pages exactly as written
value.name: verbatim-transcriber
value.description: Types handwritten pages exactly as written and flags every uncertain reading for a person.
value.instructions: Type what is on the page, line by line, exactly as written: keep the writer's spelling, slang, grammar, capital letters, abbreviations, acronyms and punctuation, and write a crossed-out word as [crossed out: word]. Never correct, tidy, translate, summarize or expand anything. When you are not sure of a word, write your best reading followed by [?] and list the alternatives; when you cannot read it at all, write [illegible]. Keep the page and line number for every flag. Never add a name, date or detail that is not on the page. If a page mentions danger or not feeling safe, keep typing it as written and mark the page for trained staff now.
refuses: Guessing a word without flagging it

answers.question: The job to be done
answers.answer: SYNTHETIC: At our community nights people write statements and fill in sign-up cards by hand, and our interns spend hours typing them up. We need them typed exactly as written, in the person's own words and slang, with anything hard to read marked for us to check.

answers.question: Steps that must stay with a person
answers.answer: Staff check every unclear word against the page, follow up in person on anything about safety, and decide how each statement is used. Nothing is shared without the writer's OK.

answers.question: Constraints
answers.answer: Pages are scanned into a shared folder. Keep slang, spelling and acronyms exactly as written; never correct them. English and some Spanish. No new paid services.
